g.text: Link Studio - ER Diagram (9 tables / 49 columns)
sess.passport.user is a logical user reference in JSON.
There is no relational FK from sessions to users.
Anonymous bootstrap sessions can also exist.
owner_id: ON DELETE SET NULL; all other FKs: CASCADE.
code: 4-32 letters/digits/_/-; generated codes use 8 characters.
original_url length: 1-2048; HTTP/HTTPS validated by API.
Tags are private; NULL expiry means no expiry.
PNG cache contains the public Short URL, not destination URL.
avatar_image and avatar_version must both be NULL or both set.
row_count BETWEEN 0 AND 10000; file contents are not stored.
Preview views are separate from redirect opens.
